dogecoin.text:
Just like the leading indicator that DOGE would fail was the fact that it was named after dogecoin. As serious as this issue is, you know it wont pass precisely bc it was given this goofy name.

Unserious people do not fix serious issues, doesn’t matter if you agree with them.

@JoshuaOgundu The fact that it was named after DOGECOIN and people thought it was a serious venture, never ceases to amaze me. 

This tendency to think you can treat government like a joke, and by some miraculous way get positive results, just doesn't work, if you actually understand things.
